summary: This standard covers the Industrial Machinery & Goods industry, which makes equipment such as engines, earth-moving machinery, trucks, tractors, ships, pumps, locomotives and turbines. Its disclosure topics are energy management, workforce health and safety, fuel economy and emissions in use-phase, materials sourcing and remanufacturing design and services.

questions.text: What is your organisation's (1) total energy consumed, (2) percentage of that energy that is grid electricity and (3) percentage that is renewable?
questions.hint: Unit: Gigajoules (GJ), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total energy consumed in GJ, (2) the percentage purchased from the grid and (3) the percentage from renewable sources, including self-generated renewable energy.

questions.text: What are your (1) total recordable incident rate (TRIR), (2) fatality rate and (3) near miss frequency rate (NMFR) for (a) direct employees and (b) contract employees?
questions.hint: Unit: Rate · Report TRIR, fatality rate and NMFR separately for direct employees and contract employees, stating the rate basis such as per 200,000 hours worked.

questions.text: What is your sales-weighted fleet fuel efficiency for medium- and heavy-duty vehicles?
questions.hint: Unit: Litres per 100 tonne-kilometres · Report the sales-weighted fleet fuel efficiency in litres per 100 tonne-kilometres.

questions.text: What is your sales-weighted fuel efficiency for non-road equipment?
questions.hint: Unit: Litres per hour · Report the sales-weighted fuel efficiency of non-road equipment in litres per hour.

questions.text: What is your sales-weighted fuel efficiency for stationary generators?
questions.hint: Unit: Kilojoules per litre · Report the sales-weighted fuel efficiency of stationary generators in kilojoules per litre.

questions.text: What are your sales-weighted emissions of (1) nitrogen oxides (NOx) and (2) particulate matter (PM) for (a) marine diesel engines, (b) locomotive diesel engines, (c) on-road medium- and heavy-duty engines and (d) other non-road diesel engines?
questions.hint: Unit: Grammes per kilojoule · Report sales-weighted NOx and PM emissions in grammes per kilojoule separately for each of the four engine categories (a) to (d).

questions.text: How does your organisation manage the risks associated with the use of critical materials?
questions.hint: Unit: Discussion, no unit · Describe the critical materials used, the risks (supply, price, regulatory, reputational) and the actions taken to manage them, such as diversification, substitution or recycling.

questions.text: What was your organisation's revenue from remanufactured products and remanufacturing services?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report revenue from remanufactured products and remanufacturing services in your presentation currency for the reporting period.

questions.text: How many units did your organisation produce, by product category?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of units produced for each product category.

questions.text: How many employees does your organisation have?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of employees; state whether it is a headcount or full-time equivalent figure.
